name: Daytona
summary: Daytona provides stateful sandboxes for running AI-generated code, each with its own kernel, filesystem and network stack, managed through SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Ruby, Go and Java. Sandboxes keep state across sessions and can be snapshotted or forked so an agent can try several approaches in parallel. It also offers Windows and GPU sandboxes, billed per second.
facts: Closed source since June 2026; earlier code remains in an archived public repo
goodFor: Long-running agents that need state between sessions
Forking a sandbox to explore parallel branches
Windows or GPU workloads in a sandbox
watchOut: No longer open source; public repo is archived
Isolation technology is not documented on the pricing page or README
